pieces.Text: A mammoth rider gains the wild empathy ability; this is exactly like the druid ability of the same name. For the purposes of this ability, her class level stacks with all other classes with the wild empathy ability. In addition, a mammoth rider can use her wild empathy to demoralize an animal or magical beast, or force it to be friendly to her, as if using Intimidate rather than Diplomacy. She adds her Strength modifier to these checks in addition to her Charisma modifier.
